svg.style: max-width:760px; height:auto; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; display:block; margin:0 auto;
svg.aria-label: The anatomy of taste shown as four nested boxes. The widest outer layer is Exposure, inside it Discrimination, inside that Point of View, and at the center Refusal, which is labeled what you ship. A bracket on the right notes that most people build only the outer layer.
svg.text: Four nested layers. Each is narrower, rarer, and harder to build than the one around it.
The reference library. Everything good and bad you have seen and can recall.
Naming WHY one thing is better than another. Feeling becomes language.
A stance: what you are FOR and AGAINST, held on purpose.
What you ship, and what you kill
The rarest layer is the smallest one. AI has drowned the outer layer. It cannot reach the core.
